title.narrative: Activity under preparation Collect More, Spend Better 2025-2027: Boosting domestic revenue mobilisation and public financial management

description.narrative: By covering both the revenue and expenditure sides of public finance, the action will help EU partner countries improve the mobilisation and use of domestic public resources, the delivery of public services and the conditions for a conducive investment climate, thus contributing to the implementation of Global Gateway. In line with the ¿Collect More, Spend Better¿ approach, the action will:-Promote fair, efficient and effective domestic revenue mobilisation (DRM) by supporting governments in improving their tax mix and addressing tax avoidance, tax evasion and illicit financial flows. The action will also strengthen international tax cooperation by supporting the work of organisations and initiatives in this field.-Support efficient and transparent economic governance through better Public Finance Management, by conducting comprehensive assessments of public finance systems. These diagnostics will inform the design of impactful reforms, through the Public Expenditure and Financial Accountability (PEFA) framework (including its gender and climate modules) and, as necessary, through other PFM diagnostic tools and through programmes in support of efficient public financial management (PFM).The Action will also contribute to the EU's Action Plan on Gender Equality and Women's Empowerment in External Relations 2020¿2025 (GAP III), especially to its thematic area of engagement ¿Promoting economic rights and empowering girls and women¿.
